title: Ijwi ry'agacece ry'ikibaya
intro: Subira inyuma urebe abantu bakomeye bigeze guhabwa igitangaza nk'ikizamini. Ubwirasi n'ubudahangarwa byashyize mu gaciro ibyababayeho. Ese ushobora gukurikirana inkuru ukamenya ibyabaye muri iyi mpinduka ikomeye?
clues: Natumwe nk'ikigeragezo cy'Imana ku bantu b'intwari bazwiho imbaraga zabo n'ubugambanyi bwabo.
Nari igitangaza kidasanzwe—abantu nkanjye batari barigeze bagaragara muri bo.
Nasangiraga amazi yo kunywa yo ku iriba n'abantu banjye mu minsi isimburana.
Baburiwe ko ikibi cyose cyankorerwaho cyazampana byihuse.
Abatinyutse kurusha abandi muri bo birengagije umuburo barantema.
Nyuma y'urupfu rwanjye, ijwi rimwe ry'inkuba riturutse hejuru ryashenye abantu banjye bose.
verse: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]. (54:29)
